program_solutions:
(rule!
  (grid-from-fn h w
    (lambda (r c)
      (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
        (if (= v 0)
            (let* ((region
                     (connected-region
                       g r c
                       (lambda (rr cc val) (not (= val 5)))
                       4))
                   (seed-count
                     (count-where
                       (lambda (p) (= (cell-at g (fst p) (snd p)) 2))
                       region)))
              (if (= seed-count 2) 8 0))
            v)))))
